baseline.method: independent original RM-Tools full288-channel synthesis and Hogbom CLEAN

relative_l2_definition: Euclidean norm of complex difference divided by Euclidean reference norm; no magnitude conversion or alignment
forward_reduced_chi2_definition: sum |P_model-P_observed|^2 / sigma^2 divided by twice the channel count; descriptive channel consistency, no fitted-parameter degrees-of-freedom correction
tolerance_rationale: Frozen before cleaned code: direct float64 Fourier versus original NUFFT eps1e-12; tolerance1e-7 allows implementation roundoff, not physical accuracy. Same-input original repeated CLEAN gives max difference0.
v2_definition: Among complex depth-bin fluxes compatible with the unchanged noise chi2 limit, accept total absolute component flux no larger than the validated standard estimate plus1e-10Jy/beam. Restoration must equal Gaussian smoothing of components plus the independent dirty residual; no hidden map agreement.
